protocol.boundary: launch through first visible normal main window

protocol.cache: warm OS filesystem caches permitted; application profiles always fresh
protocol.launcher: includes child cgroup-entry, privilege drop and exec overhead; controller and desktop excluded
protocol.cutoff: perf disable acknowledgement before shutdown; includes polling/control latency
